concerns.text: FR-001 specifies downloading **10–15** public datasets with documented outcomes, but the plan only provisions **three** verified dataset URLs (see Phase 0 description). This leaves the functional requirement under‑satisfied and may cause downstream FRs/SCs that assume a larger sample to fail.

SC-008 requires that each size‑bin (n < 50, 50‑200, >200) and each missingness level have **≥ 1** dataset. With only three datasets (all ≈ 2–3 k rows) the plan cannot satisfy the bin‑coverage requirement, risking a violation of the success criterion.
